newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Delivery to restructure board.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Delivery to restructure board.

text.p: Consolidated Delivery & Logistics Inc said Monday it will restructure its board at its annual meeting May 8.
It said it will reduce the number of directors to nine -- five independent outside directors, the chairman, the president, and two members from the founding group.
The board currently has 13 directors, seven of whom are from the founding companies. The original board had 18 members, with 12 chosen from the founding companies.

Consolidated Delivery was formed in November 1995 through the consolidation of 11 privately held companies. It is a full-service, same-day ground and air delivery and logistics company with 63 offices in 22 states and the District of Columbia.
